allow_pyramiding.description: Allow a new long in a symbol already held open in the journal.
allow_pyramiding.title: Allow Pyramiding

allow_shorts_in_bull_high_vix.description: Reference behaviour disables shorts in BULL_HIGH_VIX (defect 7.2). Set true to allow them.
allow_shorts_in_bull_high_vix.title: Allow Shorts In Bull High Vix

band_a_min.description: Raw score at or above this is band A.
band_a_min.title: Band A Min

band_b_min.description: Raw score at or above this (and below A) is band B. Below is C.
band_b_min.title: Band B Min

bar_pattern_lookback.description: Bars scanned for inside bar / mother bar.
bar_pattern_lookback.title: Bar Pattern Lookback

breakeven_at_r.description: Move stop to breakeven once price reaches entry + N x R.
breakeven_at_r.title: Breakeven At R

chart_bars.description: Daily bars exported per chart file.
chart_bars.title: Chart Bars

clip_score_display_at_100.description: Reference clipped the score at 100 (defect 7.10). Only the display value is clipped; raw and normalised are stored unclipped.
clip_score_display_at_100.title: Clip Score Display At 100

double_top_tolerance_pct.description: Two peaks within this percentage form a double top.
double_top_tolerance_pct.title: Double Top Tolerance Pct

ema_support_tolerance_pct.description: Close must be at least EMA20 x (1 - N%) for VCP support.
ema_support_tolerance_pct.title: Ema Support Tolerance Pct

keep_runs.description: Run directories kept in the repo (older pruned; git history retains them).
keep_runs.title: Keep Runs

leg_lookback_bars.description: Bars searched for the momentum leg.
leg_lookback_bars.title: Leg Lookback Bars

long_entry_max_offset_pct.description: Do-not-chase limit: entry_max = close x (1 + N%). Sizing uses this worst case.
long_entry_max_offset_pct.title: Long Entry Max Offset Pct

lookback_daily_days.description: Daily history retained per symbol (3 years; weekly trails need it).
lookback_daily_days.title: Lookback Daily Days

low_volume_bounce_factor.description: Mean volume of last 5 bars below factor x vol20 counts as low-volume bounce.
low_volume_bounce_factor.title: Low Volume Bounce Factor

max_debt_equity.description: Maximum debt to equity RATIO. yfinance reports percentage points; the provider divides by 100.
max_debt_equity.title: Max Debt Equity

max_gap_sessions.description: Reject a symbol whose bars skip more than N expected sessions.
max_gap_sessions.title: Max Gap Sessions

max_gross_exposure_pct.description: Cap on sum of open + accepted position values as % of capital.
max_gross_exposure_pct.title: Max Gross Exposure Pct

max_leg_age_bars.description: Leg window must end within N bars of the last bar (defect 7.5). null = disabled (reference behaviour).
max_leg_age_bars.title: Max Leg Age Bars

max_portfolio_risk_pct.description: Cap on sum of open + accepted risk amounts as % of capital. Enforced, candidates beyond it are deferred.
max_portfolio_risk_pct.title: Max Portfolio Risk Pct

max_position_pct_of_capital.description: Cap on a single position's value as % of capital.
max_position_pct_of_capital.title: Max Position Pct Of Capital

max_positions_per_sector.description: Maximum open + accepted positions per sector.
max_positions_per_sector.title: Max Positions Per Sector

min_avg_volume.description: Minimum average daily volume for longs. Shorts use 0.5x.
min_avg_volume.title: Min Avg Volume

min_daily_bars.description: Minimum daily bars required per symbol.
min_daily_bars.title: Min Daily Bars

min_daily_candle_pct.description: Leg also qualifies if largest single-day move in the window is at least this.
min_daily_candle_pct.title: Min Daily Candle Pct

min_eps_growth.description: EPS growth threshold used in scoring (not gated, as in reference).
min_eps_growth.title: Min Eps Growth

min_momentum_pct.description: Leg qualifies if window move is at least this.
min_momentum_pct.title: Min Momentum Pct

min_samples_for_calibration.description: Journal outcomes required before empirical hit rates are shown.
min_samples_for_calibration.title: Min Samples For Calibration

min_stop_distance_pct.description: Floor on stop distance from entry. Prevents size blow-up on tiny ranges (defect 7.1).
min_stop_distance_pct.title: Min Stop Distance Pct

min_universe_coverage_pct.description: Run marked degraded when fewer symbols than this have usable data.
min_universe_coverage_pct.title: Min Universe Coverage Pct

multibagger_arm_pct.description: Gain after which the 30-week SMA trail replaces the weekly EMA20 trail.
multibagger_arm_pct.title: Multibagger Arm Pct

partial_exit_1_r.description: First partial exit at entry + N x R.
partial_exit_1_r.title: Partial Exit 1 R

partial_exit_2_gain_pct.description: Second partial exit at entry x (1 + N%).
partial_exit_2_gain_pct.title: Partial Exit 2 Gain Pct

pledge_max_pct.description: Reserved. Not gated in v1 (no data source).
pledge_max_pct.title: Pledge Max Pct

prev_low_stop_buffer_pct.description: Previous-bar-low stop candidate = prev_low x (1 - N%).
prev_low_stop_buffer_pct.title: Prev Low Stop Buffer Pct

promoter_min_pct.description: Reserved. Not gated in v1 (no data source).
promoter_min_pct.title: Promoter Min Pct

regime_ema_fast.description: Fast EMA on Nifty for regime.
regime_ema_fast.title: Regime Ema Fast

regime_ema_slow.description: Slow EMA on Nifty for regime.
regime_ema_slow.title: Regime Ema Slow

regime_roc_bars.description: Lookback for the 18-month ROC on Nifty (uses min(N, len-1)).
regime_roc_bars.title: Regime Roc Bars

require_ban_list.description: No short plans when the F&O ban list is unavailable.
require_ban_list.title: Require Ban List

require_smallcap_confirmation_for_bull.description: Require Nifty Smallcap 100 close > EMA10 and > EMA20 for BULL. Always displayed.
require_smallcap_confirmation_for_bull.title: Require Smallcap Confirmation For Bull

risk_per_trade_pct.description: Capital risked per trade (entry to stop).
risk_per_trade_pct.title: Risk Per Trade Pct

roc_bull_max.description: BULL requires ROC(18m) below this (overextension guard).
roc_bull_max.title: Roc Bull Max

rs_lookback_bars.description: Lookback for relative strength vs Nifty (symbol ROC minus Nifty ROC).
rs_lookback_bars.title: Rs Lookback Bars

rs_score_weight.description: Points awarded when rs_vs_nifty > 0. Default 0 so enabling is explicit.
rs_score_weight.title: Rs Score Weight

short_avg_volume_factor.description: Short gate volume = factor x min_avg_volume.
short_avg_volume_factor.title: Short Avg Volume Factor

top_n_longs.description: Long candidates kept after sorting by raw score.
top_n_longs.title: Top N Longs

top_n_shorts.description: Short candidates kept after sorting by raw score.
top_n_shorts.title: Top N Shorts

trail_ema_weeks.description: Weekly EMA length for the Stage 2 trail. Computed from real weekly bars.
trail_ema_weeks.title: Trail Ema Weeks

trail_sma_weeks.description: Weekly SMA length for the multibagger trail. Computed from real weekly bars.
trail_sma_weeks.title: Trail Sma Weeks

treat_missing_fundamental_as.description: Uniform handling of a missing fundamental field: reject the symbol, pass the gate, or exclude from run with status fundamentals_missing.
treat_missing_fundamental_as.title: Treat Missing Fundamental As

universe_stale_days.description: Warn when the universe snapshot is older than this.
universe_stale_days.title: Universe Stale Days

vcp_depth_max.description: Maximum pullback depth from leg high.
vcp_depth_max.title: Vcp Depth Max

vcp_depth_min.description: Minimum pullback depth from leg high.
vcp_depth_min.title: Vcp Depth Min

vcp_recent_volume_bars.description: Bars used for the recent-volume mean in the dry-up test.
vcp_recent_volume_bars.title: Vcp Recent Volume Bars

vix_long_suppress.description: BULL with India VIX above this becomes BULL_HIGH_VIX (size x0.5).
vix_long_suppress.title: Vix Long Suppress

volume_dry_pct.description: Mean volume of last 10 bars must be below this share of leg mean volume.
volume_dry_pct.title: Volume Dry Pct

weak_bounce_max_ratio.description: Bounce counts as weak when retrace ratio is below this.
weak_bounce_max_ratio.title: Weak Bounce Max Ratio

weak_bounce_method.description: single_bar_high = reference formula using high[-40] as denominator. swing_high = highest high between pivot swing start and swing low (defect 7.6 correction).
weak_bounce_method.title: Weak Bounce Method
